capabilities: Capture first guesses with confidence levels
Review due cards with FSRS scheduling
extras: Works offline by default; online source lookup and AI are opt-in. Browser capture needs a separate Chrome extension. Cloud AI usage may be billed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to test understanding, calibrate confidence, or schedule recall after learning.

relations.evidence: Install Curiosity Capture from its local extension package.

requires.name: Local AI provider (Ollama, LM Studio, or CLI)

summary: Learning workflow plugin that captures first guesses, runs diagnostic tests, and schedules recall cards with FSRS.
